senses.gloss:
m. (-लिः)
1 A large black bee.
2 A scorpion.
3 The sign Scorpio.
4 A crow.
5 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
6 Spirituous liquor.
E.
अल to be able, &c. and इण Uṇādi aff.

mfn. sub. (-लिः-लिः) or ली-लि
1 Pure, honest, sincere.
2 Useless, idle, unmeaning.
f. (-लिः-ली)
1 A woman's female friend.
2 A row or range, a continuous line.
3 A ridge or mound of earth, crossing ditches, dividing fields, &c.
4 A line, a race or family.
m. (-लिः)
1 A scorpion.
2 A bee: see अलि.
E.
अल to adorn, to be able, &c. affix इण and the pen. made long; also आली, affix ङीप्.

f. (-ली)
1 A female friend.
2 A row or range.
3 A field, boundary or mound: see आलि.

n. (-कं)
The forehead.
E.
अल to adorn, &c. and इकन् affix; also अलीक.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 False.
2 Unpleasing.
3 Small, little.
n. (-कं)
1 Falsehood, untruth.
2 Any thing displeasing.
3 Heaven.
4 The forehead.
E.
अल to adorn, &c. and कीकच Uṇādi aff.

n. (-लं)
A flight or a number of bees.
E.
अलि, and कुल a number.

m. (-र्द्धः)
A snake, the black Cobra.
E.
अलि, and गर्द्ध to sound, affix अच्; hissing like the scorpion.

mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि)
An impostor, a pretended ascetic or student, one wearing the usual marks, as the frontal marks, skin, staff, &c. without belonging in reality to a religious order.
E.
अ neg. लिङ्ग sectarial mark, इनि aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि)
Embracing.
m. (-ङ्गी)
A small drum shaped like a barley corn, and carried upon the breast.
E.
आलिङ्ग an embrace, and इनि affix; also आलिङ्गी fem. ङीप् aff.

f. (-का)
The uvula or soft palate. Also अलिजिह्विका.

m. (-रः)
An earthen water jar.
E.
अलिम् strength, acc. of अलि and जॄ to waste, अच् aff.

m. (-रः)
A large clay water jar.
E.
अलिञ्जर a jar. अण् aff.

m. (-ली)
1 A large black bee.
2 A scorpion.
E.
अल a sting, and इनि aff.

m. (-ली)
A scorpion.
E.
see. आलि, affix इनि.

m. (-न्दः)
A terrace before a house.
E.
अल to adorn, &c. and किन्दच् affix; also आलिन्द.

m. (-न्दः)
1 A terrace before a house.
2 A raised place or terrace for sleeping upon.
E.
अलिन्द the same, and अण् affix: see अलिन्द, also आलिन्दक.

m. (कः)
1 A large black bee.
2 A scorpion.
3 A dog. Also read अलिम्पक and अलिमक.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Ignorant of reading and writing.
E.
अ neg. लिपि writing, ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-यं)
The red lotus, (Nymphoea rubra.)
f. (-या)
The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
E.
अलि a bee, and प्रिय beloved, the object of the bee's affections: the lotus especially is so described by the poets.

f. (-प्सा)
Freedom from desire or cupidity.
E.
अ neg. and लिप्सा wish.

m. (-कः)
1 A frog.
2 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
3 A large black bee.
4 The filaments of the lotus.
5 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.)
E.
अलि from अल to adorn, मकच् affix; also अलिपक.

f. (-ला)
A flight of bees.
E.
अलि, and माला a necklace.

m. (-कः)
1 A bee.
2 The Kokila.
3 A dog.
4 The filaments of the lotus.
E.
अ neg. लिपि to smear, वुन् affix; also read अलिवकः and अलिम्बकः.

m. (-वः)
The hum of bees.
E.
अलि, and विराव sound.

n. (-तं)
The song or hum of the bee.
E.
अलि, and विरुत sound.

f. (-ता)
Falsehood, vanity: also अलीकत्व.
E.
तल् or त्व added to the last.

m. (-त्स्यः)
A cake of beans fried with Sesamum oil.
E.
अलीक unreal, मत्स्य fish.

n. (-नं)
Embracing, an embrace.
E.
आङ् before लिगि to approach, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Embraced.
E.
आङ् before लिगि to approach, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ङ्ग्यः-ङ्ग्या-ङ्ग्यं)
To be embraced.
m. (-ङ्ग्यः)
A small drum: see the preceding.
E.
आलिङ्ग and ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Smeared, plastered, anointed.
E.
आङ् before लिप to smear, क्त aff.

m. (-नः)
Whitening or painting the floor, wall, &c. on festival occasions. आङ्, लिपि to plaster, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Eaten.
2 Licked.
n. (-ढं)
An attitude in shooting, the right knee advanced, the left leg retracted.
E.
आङ्, लिह to lick, क्त aff.

n. (-कं)
The frolicking of a calf. Sometimes written आढीलक.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Melted, fused.
E.
आङ् before ली to melt, क्त aff.

n. (-कं)
Tin.
E.
आलीन and affix वुन्.
